title: Mean--Fluctuation Dynamics at the Edge of Stability
abstract: arXiv:2606.05326v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the dynamics of gradient descent in the Edge of Stability regime, where the learning rate is large enough to induce persistent oscillations in the trajectory, which has been linked to better generalization performance. We introduce the mean--fluctuation dynamics, a tractable continuous-time model coupling the window-averaged trajectory to its fluctuation covariance. Among our contributions, we rigorously derive this model from gradient descent in a sharp-valley framework, characterize its stationary states and their linear stability, and establish precise connections with other effective dynamics. Numerical experiments illustrate these predictions and their finite-time limitations. We also study our model in the overparametrized regime of wide two-layer networks at a fixed learning rate, where we rigorously derive a kinetic equation describing weights and their fluctuations as a Wasserstein-2 gradient flow, for which w

translated_title: 稳定性边缘处的均值—涨落动力学
translated_abstract: 我们研究梯度下降在“稳定性边缘”（Edge of Stability）机制下的动力学，其中学习率大到足以使轨迹产生持续振荡，而这一现象已被认为与更好的泛化性能相关。我们提出了均值—涨落动力学，这是一个可解析处理的连续时间模型，它将窗口平均后的轨迹与其涨落协方差相耦合。我们的贡献包括：在尖锐谷框架下从梯度下降严格推导出该模型，刻画其稳态及其线性稳定性，并与其他有效动力学建立精确联系。数值实验验证了这些预测及其在有限时间内的局限性。我们还在固定学习率下、宽两层网络的过参数化机制中研究了该模型，其中我们严格推导出一个动力学方程，将权重及其涨落描述为一种Wasserstein-2梯度流。
tldr: 本文提出“均值—涨落动力学”这一可解析的连续时间模型，从梯度下降在稳定性边缘机制（大学习率引发持续振荡）下的行为中严格推导而来，将窗口平均轨迹与其涨落协方差耦合，并在宽两层网络的过参数化情形下推导出将权重及其涨落描述为Wasserstein-2梯度流的动力学方程。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "mean–fluctuation dynamics," a tractable continuous-time model rigorously derived from gradient descent in the Edge of Stability regime that couples the window-averaged trajectory to its fluctuation covariance, and further derives a kinetic equation describing weights and their fluctuations as a Wasserstein-2 gradient flow in overparametrized wide two-layer networks.
